_about: Every word a player reads. Keys are what the core asks for; {placeholders} are filled by the core. Rules for every string: TONE.md. Terms: GLOSSARY.md.
game.name: Mage Tower Battle
title.blurb: The last archmage was fired and wrecked the library on his way out. Read what he left on the floor, make spells, recruit students and teach them, then watch your tower hold against everything the day sends.
setup.heading: A match against three rivals
setup.text: Each day is a preparation and then a battle at every tower at once. Damage to your tower lowers your score; the highest score after the last day wins.
prep.walk_hint: Walk with WASD or the arrow keys. Stand at a station to use it. E does a station's main thing; Esc cancels.
prep.busy: Finish or cancel what you are doing first.
prep.no_mana: Not enough mana yet. It comes back over the day.
busy.interview: Interview: press J, K or L as each note reaches the line, and Space for the closing spell.
busy.drawing: Draw the glyphs in one stroke with the mouse: press, trace the line, let go.
library.none_yet: Pick up a book to learn what is in it.
lab.draft_empty: Add pieces in order: a payload first, modifiers before what they change, a trigger before what it starts.
lab.too_long: A spell holds six pieces at most.
lab.no_payload_first: Start with a payload: a trigger needs something to start from.
lab.trigger_at_end: A trigger needs a payload after it.
lab.modifier_at_end: A modifier needs a payload after it.
lab.invade_without_summon: Invade needs a summon after it, before any trigger.
lab.too_deep: Three triggers is the most a spell can hold.
lab.helper: A helper is summoned on its own, at the podium or the recruitment table.
lab.place_only: Raise Sub-tower is placed from the map table.
lab.unknown: You have not learned that piece yet.
lab.bad: That piece is not in the spell.
podium.no_students: There are no students to teach.
podium.no_spell: Save a spell at the laboratory first.
helper.unknown: You have not learned that helper.
jobs.heading: At work
draw.bad: That drawing could not be read.
book.text: What the next battle brings to your tower, and invasions you can send.
book.students_hidden: show here when the battle starts
book.bad: Choose a rival and an invasion.
book.not_invasion: Only a spell that starts with Invade can be sent.
map.text: {n} things placed. Open the map to change the layout.
map.how: Pick something, then drag across the map to lay it a cell at a time; right-drag rubs out and gives the mana back. Each cell rises in a moment. A wall may bend the route but never close it. Esc closes the map.
map.none_known: You have not learned anything you can place.
map.golem_cost: no mana, {s} s for a golem
layout.closes_path: That would close the route to your tower.
layout.unknown: You have not learned how to raise that.
summary.heading: Day {day}: how every tower held
summary.text: Damage taken comes off each score.
summary.row: took {taken}, killed {kills}, froze {frozen}, charmed {charmed}, ward took {warded}, sent {dealt}
results.title: Back to the title
waiting.heading: Waiting for the other towers
waiting.text: The battle starts when every plan has arrived.
save.broken: Your saved progress could not be read, so it starts again.
help.1.head: The day
help.1.text: Each day you have a few minutes to prepare, then every tower is attacked at once and you watch. Time is what you spend: walking, reading, interviewing and teaching all take it.
help.2.head: Library
help.2.text: Read the books on the floor. Each teaches a spell piece, or a whole spell.
help.3.head: Spell laboratory
help.3.text: Join pieces into a spell, left to right: modifiers change the next payload, a trigger starts the rest when the payload hits, dies or ends. Strong spells with short cooldowns cost much more mana.
help.4.head: Recruitment table
help.4.text: Interview applicants with a short rhythm game. A better interview brings a better student.
help.5.head: Podium
help.5.text: Teach a spell by drawing its glyphs in one stroke. Teaching one student forgives a shaky line; a whole class needs a careful one. How well you draw is how well they learn.
help.6.head: Map table
help.6.text: You start knowing Glass Wall and Raise Sub-tower; books teach more. Pick one at the map table and click a cell. It costs its mana at once and rises up to {raise_max} s later, while you do other things. A slow golem builds for no mana instead. A wall may bend the route but never close it.
help.7.head: Invasion book
help.7.text: See what the next battle brings, and send invasions. Spells that start with Invade send summons at a rival: yours show in their book at once, your students' only when the battle starts.
help.8.head: The battle
help.8.text: Students cast from the tower and sub-towers. Some types hurt others double or half; none is immune. An enemy that reaches your tower strikes it once and is gone.
help.9.head: Winning
help.9.text: Your score starts at {score} and only falls. The highest score after the last day wins.
page.no_webgl: This game needs WebGL 2, which this browser does not offer.
online.heading: Online play
online.text: Up to four archmages, each in their own browser. One hosts and shares a room code or a link; the others type the code in, or open the link, and join. Empty seats go to computer rivals. If a room code will not connect, try pasted codes: the host sends an invitation by any message app, and the joiner sends a reply back.
online.name: Your name
online.code_is: Room code: {code}. Send it, or the link, to the people you are playing with: opening the link joins this room.
online.settings: The match: {days} days, {prep} of preparation and {battle} of battle each day, from the host's Versus settings.
online.not_everyone_ready: Everyone in the room has to be ready first.
online.in_lobby: In the room. Press Ready when you are.
online.garbled: A message from another browser made no sense and was ignored.
online.reload: The host is running a different version. Reload the page, and ask them to reload too.
online.full: That room is full, or its match has started.
online.left: A player left. Their tower stands with what they had sent.
online.host_left: The host left. The match goes on here without the other players.
online.desync: This browser's scores no longer match another player's. The match goes on, but the results may differ between you.
online.no_relay: No relay answered. Check the connection, or try pasted codes.
online.no_path: The two browsers could not reach each other. Try another network, or pasted codes.
page.invite_prompt: Send this invitation to the player joining, then paste their reply below it and press Connect.
page.reply_ready: Send this reply back to the host.
page.copy_failed: This browser would not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
page.signal_failed: That code did not work. Check it was pasted whole.
page.bad_code: A room code is four to eight letters and digits.
help.10.head: Helpers and elementals
help.10.text: A helper is a spell piece a book teaches, such as Teaching Elemental, Recruitment Elemental or Mana Trainer. Once you know one, stand at the podium (or the recruitment table, for the Recruitment Elemental) and press its Summon button, then draw its glyph. It costs mana, works on its own for a while, and does its job as well as you drew it.
help.11.head: Invasions
help.11.text: Read the Invade piece from a library book. At the spell laboratory, start a spell with Invade and follow it with a summon, such as Lava Elemental, and save it. At the invasion book, press Send: it costs {pct}% of the spell's mana, and its summons join every rival's next battle. Students taught an invasion send it at every rival when the battle starts. Practice has no rivals, so nothing can be sent there.
help.12.head: The glossary
help.12.text: Press G or the Glossary button at any time to read about every spell piece, your saved spells, every word the game uses and how to do each thing. A game against the computer waits while it is open.
gloss.heading: Glossary
gloss.pieces_text: Every spell piece in the game, by number. Books in the library teach the ones you do not know yet.
gloss.spells_text: The spells you have saved, in the order you saved them.
gloss.no_spells: You have saved no spell yet. Join pieces at the spell laboratory.
gloss.no_match: Your spells show here during a match.
gloss.terms_text: What each word in the game means.
gloss.how_text: How to do each thing in the game.
gloss.paused: The day waits while the glossary is open.
gloss.payload: On its own: power {power}, cooldown {cooldown} s.
gloss.raises: At the map table: rises in {s} s.
gloss.helper: Summoned by drawing its glyph, then it works for {s} s.
view.hint: Drag a view to turn it, right-drag or Shift-drag to move it, and turn the mouse wheel to zoom. Each view keeps its own camera.
lab.invade_first: Invade goes first: an invasion is a spell that starts with Invade.
gloss.tome_text: A book of a whole spell: every piece in it is now yours, and the spell goes to your laboratory when there is room.
news.heading: What's new
title.tagline: Read the floor. Teach the class. Hold the tower.
controls.heading: Controls
map.route: The route: {n} cells (the bare field's is {was}).
office.text: Your class of {n}. Open a student to see them and choose where they stand and what they cast.
office.no_students: No students yet. Hire some at the recruitment table.
office.about: Leans to {good}, away from {bad}. Quality {q}. Their leanings move how well they learn a school's spells, a little either way.
office.where: Where {name} stands, and what they cast
office.seats_text: Tower seats and sub-tower seats have full range; the ground has less. Sub-towers appear here once raised.
office.mode_best_text: Casts the first spell that is ready.
office.mode_rotation_text: Casts the spells below in order, then starts again; a step waits for its cooldown and mana.
office.mode_one_text: Casts only the first spell below.
office.bad: That choice is not open to this student.
gloss.students_text: Each student's numbers. Office hours, the desk in the tower room, is where you change where they stand and what they cast.
gloss.student: Mana {mana}, {regen} a second. Stands: {seat}. Leans: {leans}. Taught: {taught}.
lab.branch_first: A branch needs a trigger before it.
lab.branch_twice: A spell has one branch at most.
busy.sealing: Sealing the spell: turn each ring until its glyph sits under the star.
seal.heading: Seal {spell}: ring {n} of {of}
seal.hint: A and D turn the ring; Space locks it under the star. Locked off the star, it turns a step away.
builder.branch_row: Branch: when the same trigger fires
builder.how: Each set reads left to right: optional modifiers, a payload, a trigger. A trigger opens the next set; a branch starts a second row from the first trigger. Click a tile to add it, click a placed piece to take it out.
busy.sorting: Sorting the pile: shelve each book by its school before it lands.
sort.heading: Sort the pile: {n} of {of} shelved
sort.hint: Press the shelf's number, 1 to 5, or click it. A miss sends the book back, and the next falls faster.
library.golem: Wake the librarian golem: a book every {s} s
library.golem_busy: The librarian golem is already searching.
library.dud: {value} again: a book you already know. Sort again for a new one.
lab.self_only: A spell on yourself is cast with Q, not added to a spell.
self.unknown: You know no spell to cast on yourself.
gloss.self: Cast on yourself from anywhere with Q or its icon by the HUD: {mana} mana, for {s}.
